name: qa-test-reporting
description: Test reporting and coverage analytics: JUnit XML, LCOV and Cobertura parsing, Allure reports, coverage diffs, and test run summaries for pull requests. Also covers JaCoCo and coverage.py analysis, risk-ranked coverage targets, TestRail / Xray / Zephyr Scale result sync, and Currents analytics. Agents (daily-test-suite-aggregator, release-quality-report-agent) roll up daily results across suites and assemble a release-quality go / no-go report. Jest and Vitest coverage lives in qa-unit-tests-js.
